day.title: Pace plan
day.noteLong: First 5 km 5–10 s/km slower than goal. Save energy for the finish.
day.noteMid: First 3 km ~5 s slower, goal pace from km 4, last km all out.
day.noteShort: Controlled and strong from the start, no sprinting. Last km all out.

finalWeek.title: Final week
finalWeek.tip1: Taper: cut the volume but keep short strides to stay sharp.
finalWeek.tip2: Test your breakfast and full kit before the race. Nothing new on race day.
finalWeek.tip3: Spread carbs across meals instead of one big meal.
finalWeek.tip4: Sort the logistics: route to the start, bib pickup and drop bag.
finalWeek.tip5: Sleep well the two nights before. The night before is often restless, and that's fine.
finalWeek.tip6: Shakeout the day before if you like: 15–20 min easy plus a few strides.
